result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed, but there is a clear data formatting bug ("€NaN delivery") in the "Fastest near you" carousel, plus several layout/consistency issues: the third carousel card is clipped with truncated text, the favorite heart icons use inconsistent styling, and the bottom pizza card is cut off by the tab bar without visible label.

issues.description: The "Smash Bros Burgers" card shows "€NaN delivery" instead of a valid price, indicating an undefined/non-numeric value being passed into the currency formatter.
issues.suggestion: Guard the delivery fee formatting against null/undefined values — fall back to '€0 delivery' or 'Delivery fee unavailable' and fix the upstream data field.

issues.description: The third card in the "Fastest near you" horizontal list is clipped by the viewport edge and its title is cut off ("Trattoria Piccol..."), with no ellipsis, so the restaurant name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Add proper peek/padding for the carousel so partially visible cards are clearly scrollable, and apply text truncation with ellipsis to titles.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is abruptly cut by the fixed bottom tab bar with no visible name, rating or fade, making the page feel truncated rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: The notification bell badge dot and the category chip row rely on visual cues only; the truncated 'See all' links and icon-only buttons (bell, hearts) likely lack accessible labels.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels/alt text for icon-only controls (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites').
